يعتورون (form VIII)
# يَعْتَوِرُونَ (yaʕtawirūna) /jaʕ.ta.wi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
# يُعْتَوَرُونَ (yuʕtawarūna) /juʕ.ta.wa.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
